description_en: Creates a power generation forecast task with historical data from a file URL
description_zh: 创建发电功率预测任务，历史数据来自文件url
kebab_example: aliyun brain-industrial create-power-forecast-by-file-url-job --device-type solarInverter --history-url https://bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/dir/target_file.csv --freq FIFTEEN_MIN --duration 1 --system-type solar --run-date 2025-01-01 --time-zone Asia/Shanghai --model-version latest --location Latitude=40.027 Longitude=120.042 Altitude=10.123 --business-key stationA --time-column runTime --value-column value --forecast-horizon DAY_AHEAD --data-mode FULL --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePowerForecastByFileUrlJob

parameters.description_en:
The device type. The device types supported by each system type are as follows:
-  solar: solarInverter (solar inverter)
- wind: windTurbine (wind turbine).

parameters.description_en:
Default value: FIFTEEN_MIN. The value must match the data frequency of the historical data. Valid values:
- FIFTEEN_MIN: 15 minutes
- FIVE_MIN: 5 minutes
- ONE_HOUR: 1 hour
- ONE_DAY: 1 day.
parameters.description_zh:

- FIVE_MIN: 5分钟
- ONE_HOUR: 1小时
- ONE_DAY: 1天
